question: Can a locally-persistent tool approval let the bridge's MCP call run under denyUnmatched?

setup.mcp: test/fixtures/fake-mcp-tool.mjs, one echo tool, stdio lineDelimitedJson, mode required
setup.prompt: Call the echo tool once with the text hi. Do not answer in text.

sessions.finalText: Echo tool call with `hi` was denied by policy (`deny_unmatched`), so no output was returned.

policyStore.reading: No approval-policy.json under the Muse config/data roots. No persistent rule was created.

finding: Under `onRequest` the bridge's MCP tool ran without an approval request, so no `localPersistent` choice was offered and no policy store was written. Under `denyUnmatched` the same call was rejected with `deny_unmatched` before any approval. The experiment cannot say whether a saved MCP tool rule would match the bridge, because Muse never offered to save one; it does show that `allowAll` remains the only mode that works without a per-user rule.
cost: 2 model turns, below the 3-turn / $0.50 cap; no approval-policy file to clean up
branch: D186/D187 variant: A2 stands; O9 default A. The rule-survival half is unmeasured, not answered.
